paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Графиката илюстрира промените в коефициента на разредеността (sparsity ratio) на изхода от SDPA при праг 1e-3 за различни слоеве на модела. Заглавието на фигурата е „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3".

Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Sparsity Ratio" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0.0 до приблизително 0.8, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8).

Първата линия е в син цвят с пунктиран стил (тире-точка) и представлява „sparsity ratio before gate" със средна стойност 0.003. Тази линия остава почти постоянна и много близо до нулата по цялата дължина на оста X, като започва от приблизително 0.02 при слой 0 и се задържа на ниво около 0.01–0.02 до слой 23, където достига стойност близка до 0.

Втората линия е в оранжев цвят с точков (dotted) стил и представлява „sparsity ratio after gate" със средна стойност 0.126. Тя започва от най-високата стойност сред трите линии — приблизително 0.85 при слой 0 — и стръмно намалява до около 0.3 при слой 2 и около 0.1 при слой 5. След слой 5 спадът продължава по-плавно, като линията достига стойности около 0.02–0.03 при слоеве 10–15. В последните слоеве (около 20–23) се наблюдава лек възход до приблизително 0.05 при слой 23.

Третата линия е в зелен цвят със стил тире-точка (dash-dot) и представлява „sparsity ratio after average gate" със средна стойност 0.080. Тя започва от приблизително 0.75 при слой 0 и също стръмно намалява, достигайки около 0.2 при слой 3 и около 0.08 при слой 5. След слой 7–8 линията спада до стойности близки до 0 и остава на това ниво до слой 23, като завършва при приблизително 0.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure displays the sparsity ratio of Scaled Dot-Product Attention (SDPA) output values falling below a threshold of 1e-3, measured across different layers of a model under three conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8, with tick intervals of 0.2. A blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before the gate (average 0.003); it remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at roughly 0.02 at layer 0 and staying at or just above 0.0 throughout. An orange dotted line represents the sparsity ratio after the gate (average 0.126); it begins at approximately 0.85 at layer 0, drops steeply to around 0.4 by layer 2 and around 0.15 by layer 5, then continues to decrease more gradually, reaching near 0.02 around layer 15, before showing a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at layer 23. A green dash-dot line represents the sparsity ratio after an average gate (average 0.080); it starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0, decreases sharply to around 0.2 by layer 3 and approximately 0.08 by layer 5, then continues declining to near 0.0 by around layer 10, remaining essentially at zero through the remaining layers to layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output values that fall below a threshold of 1e-3, measured across different layers of a model, with the title "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3." The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to approximately 23 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to approximately 0.8 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

Three lines are shown. The first, a blue dashed line representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," remains nearly flat and close to zero across all layers, starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and staying at or near 0.01 throughout, ending near 0.0 at layer 23. The second, an orange dotted line representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," begins at approximately 0.85 at layer 0 and declines steeply through the early layers, reaching roughly 0.15 by layer 5 and continuing to decrease more gradually to near 0.02–0.05 around layers 15–20, with a slight uptick to approximately 0.05 at layer 23. The third, a green dash-dot line representing "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," starts at approximately 0.75 at layer 0 and also declines sharply, falling to roughly 0.10 by layer 5, then continuing to decrease to near 0.0 by layer 10, where it remains close to zero through layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt die Sparsity Ratio des SDPA-Outputs bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-3, aufgetragen über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet, ebenfalls linear skaliert, und reicht von 0.0 bis etwa 0.8, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0.2 (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil (dash-dot) und ohne auffällige Marker, repräsentiert die „sparsity ratio before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.003; sie verläuft nahezu konstant auf einem sehr niedrigen Niveau nahe 0.01 über alle Schichten hinweg, mit einem minimalen Anstieg um die Schichten 10 bis 15 auf etwa 0.02 bis 0.03, bevor sie gegen Schicht 23 wieder auf nahe 0.0 abfällt. Die zweite Linie, in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil dargestellt, repräsentiert die „sparsity ratio after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.126; sie beginnt bei Schicht 0 bei etwa 0.85, fällt steil ab auf etwa 0.4 bei Schicht 2 und weiter auf etwa 0.1 bei Schicht 6, verbleibt dann auf einem niedrigen Niveau zwischen etwa 0.02 und 0.06 für die restlichen Schichten und endet bei Schicht 23 bei etwa 0.05. Die dritte Linie, in Grün mit einem Strich-Punkt-Linienstil dargestellt, repräsentiert die „sparsity ratio after average gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.080; sie startet bei Schicht 0 bei etwa 0.75, sinkt ebenfalls steil auf etwa 0.3 bei Schicht 2 und weiter auf etwa 0.08 bei Schicht 5, fällt dann weiter auf nahe 0.0 ab und verbleibt ab etwa Schicht 8 bis Schicht 23 auf einem Niveau nahe 0.0.
